IndianOil has not been able to comply with the requirement of 50% Independent Directors and 1 Woman Independent Director on its Board as it being a Government Company under the administrative control of the Ministry of Petroleum & Natural Gas, the Directors are nominated by the Government. (#) The Ministry of Corporate Affairs has granted exemption to Government Companies from similar provisions as the evaluation of Independent Directors is done by the administrative ministry.
